questions.question: How can a local-first patient app satisfy the intended registration experience without introducing clinical cloud storage?
alternatives: Local profile registration only, clearly labelled
Optional true Sign in with Apple and tiny identity-only service
questions.falsifier: Account UI promises restored progress after reinstall but no clinical backup exists.

questions.question: Which storage/migration design preserves records with low writes and bounded resident history?
alternatives: SQLite adapter with paginated queries
Measured native alternative behind same repository interface
questions.falsifier: History loss, whole-array hydration or duplicate migration after injected crash.

questions.question: Do the frozen 6bc4d77 paths close R01-R03 on the integrated candidate?
alternatives: Accept only after current production journey replay
Reopen only the affected invariant if counterexample found
questions.falsifier: Conflicting event earns credit, schedule retains stale approval or mounted screen never becomes eligible.

questions.question: What programme may the independent patient safely use without an online treating team?
alternatives: Approved local programme package with explicit applicability/setup
Guided-only education/diary until the relevant programme is established
questions.falsifier: Selecting a procedure name unlocks unapproved protected movement.

questions.question: Which pose source and native presentation give useful feedback at the smallest measured resource cost?
alternatives: Keep current estimator
Apple Vision/Core ML candidate only after compatibility and evidence comparison
questions.falsifier: New model changes landmark/angle meaning without new method identity or validated equivalence.

questions.question: Can complete native patient journeys be reproduced in both appropriate lanes and their artifacts scrutinised?
alternatives: Hosted macOS CI with deterministic native fixtures and image artifacts
questions.falsifier: Only web screenshots or green test status are available.

questions.question: How does interval scheduling handle sleep, abandoned sessions, timezone and declined notifications?
alternatives: Explicit local calendar window and approved interval anchor; OS notification optional
questions.falsifier: Missed reminders accumulate treatment dose or the app exercises outside the approved window.

questions.question: What may count as longitudinal clinical improvement rather than a numerical difference?
alternatives: Show qualified compatible observations without automatic improvement label
Add claims only with independent repeatability/reference evidence
questions.falsifier: Synthetic fixtures or high landmark confidence are used as proof of clinical accuracy.

questions.question: Which toolchain pin yields identical local/hosted Pod metadata without weakening strict installation?
alternatives: Pin and qualify the existing 1.16.2 toolchain
Deliberately migrate local and hosted locks to another reviewed toolchain
questions.falsifier: A clean runner modifies the lock or strict installation is bypassed.

questions.question: Does a failed storage read leave existing records intact through navigation/retry/restart?
alternatives: Explicit hydration-error write barrier before migration
Transactional store with source-preserving migration and read recovery
questions.falsifier: An errored read is treated as truly empty and new persistence destroys the original.

questions.question: Which endpoint policy balances meaningful ROM, selection bias, usable coverage and between-setup repeatability?
alternatives: best-valid endpoint
typical valid endpoint
standardized stable endpoint
questions.falsifier: More noisy observations create claimed improvement without a real change.

questions.question: Can the patient and later surgeon/physio interpret an export without a connected-care backend?
alternatives: Patient-owned appointment summary plus versioned small export
Defer remote linkage while preserving origin and units
questions.falsifier: Self-report becomes clinician-verified activity, unavailable becomes zero or the screen implies active monitoring.
